Rules must mean exactly what the English says: same numbers, same conditions, same order of steps, same cross-references to page numbers. Game terms follow the glossary, with the English word in brackets at first use on a sheet for class `translated-with-original`. Card titles and Station names stay as printed. Keep sentences near the English length; the fit check comes with the PDF task, and a frame that is half again as long as its source will not fit. Add `rulebook/text/tlh/index.ts` typed as a partial record for now. Register the files with the glossary check's rulebook hook. Add any new root to the lexicon in this task. Files: one or two under `rulebook/text/tlh/`, `content/glossary.test.ts`, lexicon and glossary files.

The review notes record a back-translation of every rules frame and each difference found
